description: This Java class manages persistent configuration storage for the application, providing methods to load and save configuration data to an XML file and access the root node of the configuration.

classes.name: PersistentConfiguration
classes.description: A singleton class that handles storing and retrieving persistent configuration data using XML serialization.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PersistentConfiguration.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the configuration data from an XML file, handling errors by logging a message.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current configuration data to an XML file, logging errors if saving fails.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns a new Node object representing the root of the configuration hierarchy.
